## About
Almaden Auto Repair is a car repair and maintenance shop in San Jose. We handle routine work like oil changes as well as larger repairs.
If another shop has handed you a list of repairs, you can call us and we'll take a look and give you our own quote. One reviewer said we texted photos of what needed fixing and why.
We're open Monday through Saturday and closed Sunday. Drivers have given us a 4.4 rating across 195 Google reviews.

## Services
- Get your oil changed: Routine oil changes. One reviewer said we got back to them quickly with a price and appointment time.
- Quote on needed repairs: Call and we'll take a look at your car and tell you which repairs it actually needs.
- Replacing the engine: Larger jobs like engine work. One customer had the engine replaced on a 2019 Honda Accord.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. We're open Saturday from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, the same hours as weekdays. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 1680 Almaden Expy Ste d in San Jose.

Q: Can I wait while my oil is changed?
A: You can. One reviewer filled out a quick form and waited in the lobby for about 30 minutes.
